sections.body:

The game gets increasingly difficult as you progress, with new challenges and obstacles being added to each level.

But it's not all about the stars - power-ups and special abilities are also a key part of the game. By collecting these items, you'll be able to unlock new moves and abilities that will help you navigate the levels with ease. From mushrooms that give you an extra boost of speed to fire flowers that allow you to throw fireballs, the possibilities are endless.

One of the things that sets Mario Starcatcher apart from other arcade games is its emphasis on timing. Whether it's dodging obstacles, catching stars, or using power-ups, timing is everything in this game. With a focus on precision and accuracy, you'll need to stay focused and committed to succeed.
